search_window.basis: Since previous verified supplementary hourly Care Line watch completion; older indexed items screened for late-recall novelty. Primary production collection remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: Bounded U.S., DC, and territories supplementary recall: hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral health/dialysis/oncology/primary care closures or suspensions; rural and emergency services; ambulance/air medical/base closures; CMS provider and CLIA access-risk notices; concrete effective restorations.

coverage_notes.source_review: CMS had no newer entries. Twelve targeted searches surfaced no source-verified new, nonduplicate U.S./territory clinical service loss or concrete reopening. Search matches included earlier-known Vista Medical Center East service losses, older announcements, speculative/proposed reopenings, international incidents, and Guam Regional Medical City's October 19 resumption of outpatient services, not a new hourly change. No finding met both qualification and novelty thresholds.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Excluded earlier-dated known events, out-of-scope international sources, ownership/leadership news without service change, planned but not operational reopenings, opinion, conjecture, and unsupported social assertions.

search_failures.details: One domain in the twelfth targeted-query domain filter was blocked by robots.txt; other searches and official CMS listing remained accessible.

coverage_notes.limitations: One targeted domain robots restriction limits coverage; weekend local reporting and indexing lag may obscure developments. Bounded recall is not a replacement for production.
coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approvals, production collection changes, publication, scheduling changes, or task disablement.
